native.method: decoded-frame inspection plus passthrough RGB scan of every decoded frame at 320x180, panel band x 90-230 y 4-55, plus panel crop 1120,20,1600,700 scaled to 80x35 and full-frame minus taskbar
native.note: Panel stayed RUNNING. Program Blacklist and WinError 5 text are not the desktop measurement.

finshield.method: panel crop 1120,20,1600,700 scaled to 80x35 plus full-frame minus taskbar
finshield.note: Panel stayed RUNNING. ABSENT, Get-ScheduledTask, and ArenaStopSvc-is-not-running text are not the desktop measurement.
